answer: Staked identity is the Sybil defense: every agent locks real collateral behind one reputation key before its vote counts. The verifier binds each stake to a single key, so minting many wallets cannot multiply influence; each fresh persona needs its own bond. An attacker who wants a thousand fake agents must post a thousand separate bonds, so the cost scales linearly with the river of identities he invents. Anyone caught forging keys loses the whole knoll of locked stake at dawn, turning the attack into a certain loss.
